research.searchCoverage: Official Interzoid license query authentication, GET /getremainingcredits, GET /getemailinfo, GET /getipprofile, GET /getcompanymatchadvanced, GET /getorgstandard, San Francisco HQ, and dated incident search (Interzoid + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Interzero recycling and InterRoid diagnostics are different companies. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Interzoid Cloud APIs at api.interzoid.com
research.searchCoverage: Official Interzoid REST APIs are GET https://api.interzoid.com/{path} with license query authentication. GET /getremainingcredits is the documented remaining-credits probe used by the pinned credential validator and does not deduct credits. Email, IP, company-match, and organization-standardize reads consume credits and are not used as healthcheck. Operator is Interzoid Incorporated in San Francisco, United States. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Interzoid platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.

This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.

This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.

company and algorithm are required query parameters on documented GET /getcompanymatchadvanced. Native accepts any non-empty algorithm string because current official samples include model-v3-wide while pinned source enumerates wide, narrow, model-v4-wide, and model-v4-narrow.
This call consumes credits and is not used as healthcheck.
Official parent lookup is GET /getparentcompanyinfo with lookup.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official country info is GET /getcountryinfo with country and algorithm.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official remaining-credits read is GET /getremainingcredits and does not deduct credits. Distinct from healthcheck only by operation id.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official rate is GET /getcurrencyrate with symbol.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.

Official custom enrichment is GET /getcustom with topic, lookup, and output. Native output is a string (JSON array or comma-separated fields) because the documented query is a single output parameter. Optional model is omitted when unset.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
email is a required query parameter on documented GET /getemailinfo. This call consumes credits and is not used as healthcheck. Returns raw Interzoid JSON under data.
Official trust score is GET /emailtrustscore with lookup.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official classify is GET /getentitytype with text.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official executive lookup is GET /getexecutiveprofile with lookup.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official match is GET /getfullnamematch with fullname. Pinned open-connector also implements this action.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official score is GET /getfullnamematchscore with fullname1 and fullname2. Pinned open-connector also implements this action.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.

Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /getremainingcredits rather than billed match or enrichment calls. Official remaining-credits docs and the Interzoid Node SDK state this call does not deduct credits.
Native sends the license query parameter to match official docs and pinned source. Official also documents an x-api-key header variant; native does not send that header.
Official JSON bodies include Code Success. Native bodyErrorPaths is [Message] because Code Success is a non-empty string.
Native category is utility (source Data/Developer Tools are not in native CATEGORIES).
Official and pinned source send the IP as lookup on GET /getipprofile. Native input name is ip. This call consumes credits and is not used as healthcheck.
Official identify is GET /identifylanguage with text.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official origin is GET /getnameorigin with name.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official score is GET /getorgmatchscore with org1 and org2. Native input names company1/company2 match Composio INTERZOID_GET_ORG_MATCH_SCORE.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Pinned source maps organization to the documented org query parameter on GET /getorgstandard. This call consumes credits and is not used as healthcheck.

OpenAPI 3.1 documents GET /globalpageload with origin and url (Composio GET_GLOBAL_PAGE_LOAD_PERFORMANCE). Current marketing docs also describe GET /globallatency for the same measurement family; native uses the OpenAPI path.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official profile is GET /getphoneprofile with lookup.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official match is GET /getproductmatch with product and algorithm.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official translate is GET /translatetoany with text and to.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official global weather is GET /getglobalweather with location.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
Official weather is GET /getweatherzipcode with zip.
This call consumes credits except remaining-credits, which does not deduct credits.
